source.title: Warranty Claim
source.description: I can repair that processor for you, but I need a somewhat hard-to-get item; a Charged Voidcore. Naga spell casters are known to carry these and while I can't be sure where the Naga get them or how they are made, they tend to act as powerful foci for certain types of magical rituals. They are the key component to my G-7 C.O.R.E. Processor unit. They aren't common so you may be in for a tough time finding one.
source.objective: Bring Wirdal Wondergear a Charged Voidcore.
source.progress: I shudder to think how many Naga you had to clobber to get this thing.
source.completion:
Well here goes nothing.

I feel compelled to give you the disclaimer that I won't be held responsible for any electrical fires, electromagnetic pulse bursts, demonic manifestations, or interdimensional vortexes that may result from the installation and usage of this processor.
